reads.note: Same crossing as t06_37L. Only 'ST.' (NE segment) and the tail of 'GERINGER' are printed on 37R. Geringer centreline x ~ 400 - 0.53*(y-3100); Ralston centreline meets it at ~(210,3458). Unnamed 60' stub to the canal leaves W from the same point.

Ralston runs WSW from Spring Grove; its south edge is the north line of block 70 (~(225,3500)-(357,3467)), its north edge block 67's south line extended past a small triangular lot. Its centreline meets Geringer's straight NE-SW centreline at the north tip of block 70. Directly opposite on the west side of Geringer an unnamed 60' street (between blocks 65 and 66, centre ~(170,3453) at Geringer's west edge) leaves toward the NW/canal, so physically a four-way crossing; only Ralston is named. The open area to the NE (triangle lot, Groub's mouth) is part of the same plaza.
